Which events of a row's log are the round's executions

log_executions.Rd

The writes of applied_seal, which the round makes only when it has applied the row, newest first as the log holds them. With the channel's account configured only the channel's writes count (decided on 2026-10-17): the import right is open to the referents, and a seal one of them imported, alone or in the same event as a change, would otherwise stand as the last execution, and the change below it would read as carried out. Without the account every write counts, as before: a second account writing the seal makes the channel unknown, log_channel_unknown(), and the callers stop there.

Usage

log_executions(events, channel, channel_account)

Arguments

events

The row's events, newest first.

channel

What log_channel_accounts() answered for the row.

channel_account

What it was asked with.

Value

The positions in events of the executions, newest first.

Details

The channel's event has to have the form of the seals door, too: details holding applied_seal and at most seal_state beside it, nothing else. The door has written only those two fields since the seal exists, and REDCap logs only the fields an import changed. Read by the field name alone, an outcome of the channel whose applied_as quotes a seal, from a group name somebody chose on the instance, would pass for an execution and move the boundary above a change.
